findings.title: Death and beneficial life remain unavailable together
findings.claim: The focus holds a person between death as the ending of vital power and life as a beneficial, protective outcome, so the fire condition becomes a suspension of both closure and rescue.
findings.mechanism: The focus death carrier is joined to the exact punishment parallel in 20:74, while its life carrier meets the beneficial-life contrast in 16:97; those independent wider contacts make the paired negations functionally opposed rather than a single vague paradox.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the two denials matter separately: one withholds an ending and the other withholds the kind of life that would constitute deliverance.
findings.containment: The ordinary bodily death and life predicates remain intact. This finding does not turn the phrase into a claim about a literal biological midpoint, and it coexists with the living-being, ecological, and cognitive contacts below.

epistemic.reason: A trusted published finding supplies the paired semantic relation, while the wider benefit formulation is additionally carried by an unbound reader-walk record and connection nominations without target morphology.

findings.title: Continuance without settling or renewal
findings.claim: The double negation can hold the fire condition as a sterile continuation: it does not reach the stillness of a sleep-like cessation and does not produce the rain-like renewal of living earth.
findings.mechanism: The life carrier meets the supplied dead-earth-and-rain sequence in 7:57, while the death carrier meets 39:42's explicit distinction between sleep and final death; the two contacts give the paired verbs opposed ecological and settling functions.
findings.reader_payoff: The condition becomes an ongoing process with no restful settling and no fresh productive return, rather than an abstract midpoint between two dictionary opposites.
findings.containment: The fire is not identified literally with land, rain, wind, or sleep. These are contextual images applied through the focus verbs, and the static permanent-state reading remains live alongside the processual one.

epistemic.reason: The paired finding is trusted, while its processual and sleep-like development is also carried by an unbound reader-walk record; the wider connection targets lack supplied morphology.
